title.de: thanksgiving eve bar crawl in der innenstadt.

line.en: the official crawl starts at 7 pm and runs to about midnight; tickets on eventbrite. one listing says 8 pm, so check the start.
line.de: der offizielle crawl beginnt um 19 uhr und läuft bis etwa mitternacht; tickets bei eventbrite. eine liste nennt 20 uhr, also start prüfen.
line.tr: resmi crawl akşam 7'de başlıyor, yaklaşık gece yarısına kadar sürüyor; biletler eventbrite'ta. bir liste 8 diyor, başlangıcı kontrol et.

sparks.why: Houston Official Thanksgiving Eve Bar Crawl 2026 on Eventbrite, Wed 25 Nov 7 pm to about midnight; a second listing gives 8 pm at a Brazos Street bar, so the start is not fully confirmed.
